title: Hashed Occupancy Grid + Dijkstra Planner
hints: toCell: `static_cast<int>(std::floor(x / res))`. Plain truncation is wrong for negative coordinates.
CellHash: mix the two ints so that (a,b) and (b,a) differ, e.g. pack into 64 bits: `(uint64_t(uint32_t(c.x)) << 32) | uint32_t(c.y)` and hash that, or use hash_combine.
Dijkstra: `std::unordered_map<Cell,double,CellHash> dist;` and a min-heap of `std::pair<double, Cell>` with a lambda comparing `.first` with `>`. Skip stale entries: `if (d > dist[u]) continue;`.
Neighbours: loop dx, dy in {-1,0,1} (skip 0,0); step cost = (dx && dy) ? sqrt(2) : 1. Skip cells outside [lo, hi] or with occ hits >= min_hits.
